4기. AI 융합으로 도약하다: Phase 4. A leap into AI convergence
OCPP 솔루션 런칭을 시작으로 자체 솔루션 사업을 본격화하고, Cube: Beginning with the OCPP solution launch, OCUBE moved in earnest into its own solution business and released AI-based solutions such as CubeOn along with new products (Mini PCI LTE Cat M1) — the turn toward an AI convergence company.
3기. 산업의 경계를 넘다: Phase 3. Crossing the boundaries of industry

2기. 신뢰로 입지를 넓히다: Phase 2. Widening our ground through trust
강소기업 선정, 국무총리 표창 등 정부·지자체의 잇따른 인정과 함께, Q: Recognised in turn by government and local authorities — named a strong small enterprise and awarded the Prime Minister's Citation — while expanding global partnerships with Qt, Gemalto and VisualOn, earning outside recognition for embedded and SI expertise.
글로벌 모바일 플랫폼(Nokia Symbian) 공식 파트너로 출발해,: Starting as an official partner of the global mobile platform (Nokia Symbian), OCUBE laid its foundation as a technology company — venture and ISO certifications, and the first Qt Certified Partner in Korea.
